ratings_why.fun: One gold of Paying fires Chimney Jackdaw, Collector, Memory, the Ledger and Corbie at once, and interest counting as Owing quietly feeds Wassail, so every recruit turn is a real sequencing puzzle.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7: Debt gates Tier up itself, so Uncle Jack turns a Tier up into an Owe event that buffs through Wassail, Arne and Orchard Heavy; no current tribe makes the tier button a combo piece.

verdict_why: The rules now read cleanly and nothing locks or always-wins; more passes would change the flavour of the puzzle, not improve it.

points.text: Seven's exactly-7 is the best puzzle in the set: interest, Thought's Owe 1, Paying and the Fence all steer the count. Keep it exact rather than loosening it to 7 or more.

Several Skims resolve in reading order, so slot placement matters: Orchard Heavy and Rookery Don first, Gallows Lane Bagman last to turn leftovers into gold. Show that order on the IOU pile so players can find the trick.
Wassail Bowl-Bearer is the hidden hub: interest, Thought, Oast Usurer, Silas and Uncle Jack all Owe. Say on the card that interest counts, or most players will miss its best use.

Belfry Jackdaw pulls toward holding a single Debt forever while Bagman wants you debt-free; a nice tension. A golden or late version that pays more per Debt held would give carry builds a second economy piece.
Silas's Owe 4 after a win refills Rookery Don's Skim for the next turn, a combo the designer only half-lists; it is the engine of the Skim build and worth naming in its build text.

standouts.why: Exactly 7 Debt turns every Owe and Pay into an aiming problem.
Fires from every borrowing source, including interest, so it bridges carry and collection.
Turns Silas's thefts, Discovers and Fly South Birds into Debt cleared; the best cross-tribe hook.

weakest.why: Same per-Debt axis as Orchard Heavy, just bigger; one obvious job.
A one-time optional loan for stats; works, but no interaction beyond the Owe.
Plain once-a-turn grower that Gallows Lane Collector already covers better.

flags.note: Silas refills Debt each win and Rookery Don with Sorrow and Joy counts each Skimmed Debt twice, so a winning board can gain about +14/+14 to every unit a turn. Losing a fight breaks it, so it is counterable.
A credit Tier up is nearly always worth taking, and it also triggers Wassail; may be the auto-pick in any lobby.
Silas Owes after a fight; whether that uses this turn's or next turn's Twice-a-turn count isn't stated.
